mutations.name: a custom beat is held to its beat spec, not its built layer
kills: emphasis target gate on custom layers holds a custom beat's cues to the ids its built layer exposes, not to slots its beat spec would need

mutations.name: a target a custom layer does not expose passes
kills: emphasis target gate on custom layers fails a custom beat's cue whose target its built layer does not expose, naming what it does expose

mutations.name: the verdict lists only the first five failures
kills: emphasis gate verdict on many failures lists all seven failing cues past the fifth, each with its target and reason, and one hint per kind of failure
